4 tricks turned a normal clip into "proof"

yt.title: Slow motion
notes: Slow motion makes normal blinks look mechanical
Feb 2026: a slowed clip of her went viral; in the C-SPAN original she moves normally (Lead Stories)

yt.title: Filters guess detail

notes: A red circle, and a voice telling you what to see

yt.title: One sign per trick
notes: Everyone moves like they're underwater: slowed
Blur, screen glare, another app's logo: a copy
Waxy skin, eyes that change shape: a filter
Mute it, ignore the circle: still weird?

lines.text: Next time it lands in your group, check: [1] if everyone moves like they're underwater, it's slowed. [2] Blur, glare or another app's logo means a copy. [3] Waxy skin or eyes that change shape mean a filter. [4] Then mute it and ignore the circle: still weird?
